description_en: Queries a list of file versions
description_zh: 调用ListFileVersions查询文件的版本列表
name: ListFileVersions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the file. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 文件的ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can click the Workspace Manage icon in the upper-right corner of the DataStudio page to go to the Workspace page and view the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the identifier in the upper-left corner of the DataStudio page to switch to another workspace.

You must specify either this parameter or ProjectId to determine the DataWorks workspace to which the operation is applied
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。

该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_zh: 请求的数据页数，用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

ChangeType.description_en: The type of the change to the file of the current version. Valid values: CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE
ChangeType.description_zh: 本次文件版本的变更类型，包括CREATE、UPDATE和DELETE

Comment.description_en: The description of the file version

CommitTime.description_en: The time when the file version was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
CommitTime.description_zh: 生成文件版本的毫秒时间戳

CommitUser.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used to create the file of the current version
CommitUser.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的阿里云用户UID

FileContent.description_en: The code in the file of the current version
FileContent.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的文件代码

FileName.description_en: The name of the file of the current version
FileName.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的文件名

FilePropertyContent.description_en: The basic information about the file of the current version
FilePropertyContent.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的文本基本信息

IsCurrentProd.description_en: Indicates whether the file version is the same as the latest file version in the production environment
IsCurrentProd.description_zh: 本次文件版本是否为当前生产环境的最新版本

NodeContent.description_en: The scheduling configurations for the node that corresponds to the file of the current version
NodeContent.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的调度配置

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the auto triggered node that corresponds to the file of the current version
NodeId.description_zh: 生成文件版本时对应的调度任务ID

Status.description_en: The status of the file of the current version. Valid values: COMMITTING, COMMITTED, CHECK_OK, PACKAGED, DEPLOYING, DEPLOYED, and CANCELLED
Status.description_zh: 文件版本当前的状态，包括COMMITTING（提交中）、COMMITTED或CHECK_OK（已提交）、PACKAGED（准备发布）、DEPLOYING（发布中）、DEPLOYED（已发布）和CANCELLED（取消发布）

UseType.description_en: The functional module to which the file belongs. Valid values: NORMAL, MANUAL, MANUAL_BIZ, SKIP, ADHOCQUERY, and COMPONENT. The value SKIP indicates that the node corresponding to the file is run in dry-run mode
UseType.description_zh: 文件所属的功能模块，包括NORMAL（数据开发）、MANUAL（手动任务）、MANUAL_BIZ（手动工作流）、SKIP（数据开发的空跑调度）、ADHOCQUERY（临时查询）和COMPONENT（组件管理）

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足查询条件的数据总条数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
